title: ShipmentItem - Data API
description: Represents an order item included in a shipment. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ExpectedDeliveryDate.description: Expected delivery date of the shipment that contains the shipment item.

FulfillmentOrderLineItemId.description: The FulfillmentOrderLineItem (fulfillment order product) corresponding to the shipment item.

OrderItemSummaryId.description: The OrderItemSummary (order product summary) corresponding to the shipment item.

Product2Id.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Product2Id.description: The product represented by the shipment item. This is a relationship field.

Quantity.description: The quantity of products represented by the shipment item.

ReturnOrderLineItemId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReturnOrderLineItemId.description: For a return ShipmentItem, the associated ReturnOrderLineItem. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

ShipmentId.description: (Master-Detail) The shipment that contains the shipment item. This is a relationship field.

ShipmentItemNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
ShipmentItemNumber.description: An auto-generated number identifying the shipment item.

TrackingNumber.description: The tracking number of the shipment that contains the shipment item.

TrackingUrl.description: The tracking URL of the shipment that contains the shipment item.

special_access_rules:
At least one of these features must be enabled:

Order Management

Field Service

B2B Commerce

Health Cloud Visit Inventory

Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **ShipmentItemFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ShipmentItemHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
